messages:
Asha (PM): quick sync — we need clearer UX for when console actions are blocked by routing/quota policies, not just 'permission denied'.
Eli (Eng): +1. Users often think RBAC denies them when actually it's routing fallback to a cheaper model or tenant quota.
Priya (Design): can we show a short explainer with the chain: role -> route policy -> quota check -> fallback? maybe a compact pill.
Tom (Eng Platform): technically we have all data: request route, matched policy id, quota decision, and fallback model id. exposing policy id is fine, but we need to avoid leaking internal names.
Marta (Security): agree on non-sensitive names. show human-friendly reason: e.g., "blocked by quota: tenant limit reached" or "routed to read-only role due to quota". no raw ARNs or internal IDs.
Jon (SRE): we should include a telemetry tag so support can correlate: e.g., telemetry_ref=rbac-explain-<shorthash>. that lets us trace without exposing backend ids.
Eli (Eng): draft idea: message with three lines: 1) high-level reason 2) what changed (route/quota/role) 3) troubleshooting CTA + ref. example:
```
Permission denied: route policy prevented write to model X
Why: tenant write_quota exceeded for region-us-east-1
Next steps: request quota increase or use read-only route. ref: rbac-explain-4f2a
```
Priya (Design): UI sketch: small banner under action button in place of error modal. color amber, short copy, "+ details" expand to full trace. Also show toggle "Ask admin" that opens pre-filled request.
Marta (Security): pre-filled request should not include audit tokens, only action summary and telemetry_ref. fine.
Tom (Eng Platform): implementation notes: we'll add an enriched error object from the gateway: {code, reason, category, telemetry_ref, safe_message} — but we can't send nested JSON in the console UI show; front-end will render fields.
Eli (Eng): minimal contract: code (string), category in [rbac, quota, routing], safe_message (string), details_url (optional short link), telemetry_ref (string).
Priya (Design): for expand view include a timeline: matched role -> policy name (friendly) -> quota state -> fallback route. show timestamps.
Jon (SRE): log pattern: include telemetry_ref, tenant_id hash, route_hash, and the decision path. we can add sampling for telemetry to avoid noise.
Asha (PM): decision: add explainability banner + expand, add "request admin" CTA, include telemetry_ref. Owner: Tom for API changes, Priya for copy & UX, Eli for front-end plumbing.
Tom (Eng Platform): I'll open the API PR. note: need a migration to ensure older backends return safe_message fallback.
Eli (Eng): front-end will gracefully handle missing fields. show generic "action blocked" and link to support.
Priya (Design): copy drafts: "Action blocked due to routing or quota policy. Details" and CTA: "Request admin review". for enterprise, optional show policy excerpt sanitized.
Marta (Security): policy excerpt must be sanitized and redacted. add approval from security review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging -> infra/permissions-explainability (run id: 9823). :rocket:
Asha (PM): timeline: API PR this week, UX mock Friday, staging deploy next week. I'll follow up with PO doc.
Tom (Eng Platform): assigning myself. will add integration tests for error contract and telemetry_ref.
Eli (Eng): will add front-end tests + minimal e2e.
Priya (Design): will post mocks in #design later today.
Marta (Security): will review excerpt redaction rules after mocks.
Asha (PM): thanks all — let's keep thread for clarifications. :white_check_mark:
